title: Dukatove buchticky
instructions: Bloom yeast from the lukewarm milk, teaspoon of sugar and yeast.
Mix together flour, salt, sugar, and lemon zest.
Add wet ingredients: melted butter, egg, bloomed yeast, and work into a dough.
Work it up, form little balls, cover in butter from all sides, and put into a cooking dish.
Let it rest some more before making at 200C.
